text.value:
@concat(
'MERGE ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.target_table,
' AS T
USING ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.staging_table,
' AS S
ON T.CustomerID = S.CustomerID

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        T.CustomerName = S.CustomerName,
        T.Region = S.Region,
        T.Email = S.Email,
        T.ModifiedDate = S.ModifiedDate

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (
        CustomerID,
        CustomerName,
        Region,
        Email,
        ModifiedDate
    )
    VALUES (
        S.CustomerID,
        S.CustomerName,
        S.Region,
        S.Email,
        S.ModifiedDate
    );'
)

@concat(
    'SELECT
        CustomerID,
        CustomerName,
        Region,
        Email,
        ModifiedDate,
        __$operation AS CDC_Operation
     FROM cdc.fn_cdc_get_all_changes_',
    pipeline().parameters.schema,
    '_',
    pipeline().parameters.table_name,
    '(
        CONVERT(binary(10), ''',
    activity('Fetch_Last_CDC_LSN').output.firstRow.LastProcessedLSN,
    ''', 1),
        CONVERT(binary(10), ''',
    activity('Fetch_Current_CDC_LSN').output.firstRow.MaxLSN,
    ''', 1),
        ''all''
    )'
)

@concat(

'DECLARE @BatchTime DATETIME2 = SYSUTCDATETIME();

BEGIN TRANSACTION;

--------------------------------------------------
-- 1. EXPIRE CURRENT RECORDS FOR DELETE
--------------------------------------------------

UPDATE T
SET
    T.ValidTo = @BatchTime,
    T.IsCurrent = 0,
    T.UpdatedAt = @BatchTime
FROM ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.target_table,
' AS T
INNER JOIN ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.staging_table,
' AS S
    ON T.CustomerID = S.CustomerID
WHERE S.CDC_Operation = 1
  AND T.IsCurrent = 1;


--------------------------------------------------
-- 2. EXPIRE CURRENT RECORDS FOR UPDATE
--------------------------------------------------

UPDATE T
SET
    T.ValidTo = @BatchTime,
    T.IsCurrent = 0,
    T.UpdatedAt = @BatchTime
FROM ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.target_table,
' AS T
INNER JOIN ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.staging_table,
' AS S
    ON T.CustomerID = S.CustomerID
WHERE S.CDC_Operation = 4
  AND T.IsCurrent = 1;


--------------------------------------------------
-- 3. INSERT NEW VERSION FOR INSERT + UPDATE
--------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.target_table,
' (
    CustomerID,
    CustomerName,
    Region,
    Email,
    ModifiedDate,
    ValidFrom,
    ValidTo,
    IsCurrent,
    CreatedAt,
    UpdatedAt
)
SELECT
    S.CustomerID,
    S.CustomerName,
    S.Region,
    S.Email,
    S.ModifiedDate,
    @BatchTime,
    NULL,
    1,
    @BatchTime,
    NULL
FROM ',
pipeline().parameters.schema,
'.',
pipeline().parameters.staging_table,
' AS S
WHERE S.CDC_Operation IN (2, 4);


--------------------------------------------------
-- 4. COMMIT
--------------------------------------------------

COMMIT TRANSACTION;'

)
